comment: Test planning is integrated into architecture work, which is a strong recommendation. However, the section does not link testing to procurement stages, contractual acceptance, deployment gates, or ongoing operations.

anchor.note: p.84 l.Lines 1148-1151 read as the printed page; section 3.7.4 agrees

public.text: Test planning is integrated into architecture work, which is a strong recommendation. However, the section does not link testing to procurement stages, contractual acceptance, deployment gates, or ongoing operations.
public.suggestedRevision: Add test gates for market engagement, tender evaluation, pre-award demonstration, contractual acceptance, pre-production deployment, major upgrades, and periodic operational reassessment.
